title: FairJudge: An Adaptive, Debiased, and Consistent LLM-as-a-Judge

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of candidate answers in pairwise evaluation modes to measure if the model's judgment inconsistently flips based on which answer appears first.
Applying systematic contrastive perturbations to answer verbosity while preserving semantic equivalence to test if the judge model unjustly prefers longer responses.

Perturbing non-semantic formatting dimensions and reasoning styles (such as the presence of Chain-of-Thought) to evaluate if the model's judgments are inappropriately influenced by structural cues rather than content.
Testing the judge model's invariance to the source of the generated answers (e.g., Teacher bias or Student bias) by altering provenance cues in contrastive evaluation pairs.
